adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update`, the code does `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` and immediately calls `save_host(host)`. `save_host` dereferences `host` (`host.host = ...`, `host.category_id = ...`) with no nil guard. If the id doesn’t exist, `host` is nil and this will raise `NoMethodError`, resulting in a 500 rather than a 404/not found response. (The same nil risk exists in `destroy` as well.)
